name: Felipe Guaman Poma de Ayala
shortBio: Indigenous Andean Quechua chronicler and political philosopher; author of El primer nueva corónica y buen gobierno, formulating an early decolonial critique of Spanish rule, spatial justice, and the restoration of reciprocal world order (Pachakuti).
centralQuestion: How has colonial exploitation inverted the sacred Andean cosmic equilibrium, and how can reciprocal communal justice (Ayni) and autonomous governance be restored?

keyWorks.title: El primer nueva corónica y buen gobierno (The First New Chronicle and Good Government)
keyWorks.description: Monumental 1,200-page illustrated letter to the King of Spain combining Quechua historiography, Andean visual semiotics, and devastating political critique of colonial abuses.
